conditions: Pilot only: do not activate an organization-wide mandatory intake policy or persistent coordinator from this matter.

Represent independence with separate declared-context, authenticated-provenance-when-available, and adjudicated-independence fields; never infer independence from session/model/file identifiers alone.
Preserve every raw contribution and attachment immutably by exact content identity before normalization, synthesis, or adjudication; corrections are new linked records.

Automate only mechanically decidable classifications such as byte identity, exact dispatch binding, schema validity, explicit supersession links, and observable freshness. Semantic duplication, plagiarism, conflict meaning, and independence strength remain review-bound.

Define concurrency modes cooperative_claimed, independent_blind, and adversarial_replay, with explicit blind-cohort membership/closure. No cross-contribution synthesis before durable cohort closure; late returns remain preserved evidence with explicit late status.
Treat contributor payloads as untrusted data. Embedded instructions and executable attachments cannot trigger actions without a separate authorized sandboxed execution path.
Keep the inbox proposal-only and non-canonical. Protected dependency consumption requires ordinary exact-digest adjudication and the existing MATHSOLVE/MATHCERT/governance route.

Pilot receipts must bind dispatch identity, raw digest, attachment digests, declared context/provenance, concurrency mode, freshness, schema result, and handling state, and support idempotent replay without overwrite.

Run hostile fixtures for identifier collision, same bytes/different dispatch, different bytes/same identifier, stale live state, truncated return, blind-cohort contamination, duplicate attachment, late return, malicious embedded instruction, and transport replay.

Return pilot evidence, executor feedback, schema/validator proposal, and measured overhead to full Council review before broader institutionalization; final activation remains subject to Human Steward authority.
authority_boundary: This compilation validates and summarizes Council records. It does not approve, merge, activate, ratify, or certify.
